🐧 SIGINT // Ubuntu Watch — 2026-09-25 Public exploit for an AF_UNIX use-after-free breaking container isolation to host root, hitting 22.04/

via Mastodon https://thecybersecguru.com/news/cve-2026-80521-ubuntu-kernel-container-escape/

CVE-2026-80521.evidence: Event reports a public exploit for the AF_UNIX garbage-collector use-after-free that breaks container isolation to host root on Ubuntu 22.04 kernels.
